chart.title: Wait over time: {zone}

desks.borderHidden: Immigration desks are border data and are not shown to your role.

wave.none: No arriving flights in the window

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address does not match a screen in Ariva.

login.title: Sign in
login.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryHint: One of the recovery codes you saved when you set up the authenticator.
login.failed: The username, password or code is not correct.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.unavailable: Ariva cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
login.codeNeeded: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryLeft: You signed in with a recovery code; {count} left. Generate new ones in Account security.

setup.title: Set up your account
setup.description: Your administrator gave you a temporary password. Choose your own and set up an authenticator app.
setup.passwordRules: 12 to 128 characters. Not a common or breached password, and without your username or the product name.
setup.totpIntro: Scan this code with an authenticator app (for example Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.qrLabel: QR code to add Ariva to your authenticator app
setup.manualKey: Or enter this key by hand
setup.codeRefused: The code was not accepted. Check that the time on your phone is right and try the next code.
setup.recoveryIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe, away from your phone. Each one signs you in once if you lose the authenticator. They are shown only now.
setup.copied: The codes are copied. Paste them somewhere safe, then copy something else so they do not stay on this computer's clipboard.
setup.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the codes and copy them yourself.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.description: This action needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.

user.signOutFailed: Ariva could not end your session on the server. Sign out again when the network is back, or close the browser.

account.title: Account security
account.description: Your password, your authenticator app and your recovery codes

password.title: Password
password.done: Your password is changed. Your other sessions are signed out.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.enrolled: An authenticator app is set up for your account.
totp.notEnrolled: No authenticator app is set up for your account yet.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: New codes replace the old ones, which stop working. Enter a code from your authenticator app to generate them.

access.title: No access
access.description: Your role does not include this screen. Ask your administrator if you need it.

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: Airports, terminals, levels, checkpoints and desks of your sites
topology.readOnly: You can view the topology of your sites. Changes are made by a system administrator.
topology.deploymentWide: Airports are shared by every site; only an administrator of all sites adds or changes them.
topology.rangeHint: For example prefix D, from 1 to 22, 2 digits: D01 to D22 (at most 200).

messages.loadFailed: The topology could not be loaded: {reason}

mappings.title: Codes in other systems
mappings.description: The codes AMAN and the AODB use for this desk.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Queue, service, staff and overflow zones and their lines, on each level's floor plan
zones.readOnly: Published and retired versions never change. Start a draft to edit the zones.
zones.noRights: You can view the zones of your sites. Changes are made by the roles that own them.
zones.canvas: Floor plan with zones and lines
zones.starterZone: The zone starts as a small square in the middle of the level; drag its corners or type them in the table.
zones.starterLine: The line starts on an edge of its zone (an exit across from the entry); drag its ends along the edge or type them.
zones.vertexHandle: Corner {n} of {name} at {x}, {y} m. Arrow keys move it, Enter saves.

lineHandle.start: Start of {name} at {x}, {y} m. Arrow keys move it, Enter saves.
lineHandle.end: End of {name} at {x}, {y} m. Arrow keys move it, Enter saves.

zones.publishHint: Publishing replaces the live version for the whole site. Check the draft first; the check you saw is what gets published.
zones.checkAgain: The draft changed since the check; check it again.
zones.publishStepUp: Publishing needs a code from your authenticator app if you have not given one in the last 15 minutes.
zones.noPlan: No floor plan for this level
zones.planFile: Plan file (PNG, JPEG or SVG, at most 20 MB)
zones.planHint: The scale and origin place the image on the level: origin is where its top left corner lies, in metres.
zones.unsaved: Save or undo the changes on the plan first: publishing takes the saved draft.
zones.laneHint: The lane category whose queue this is: the immigration screen shows its wait for that lane.
zones.capacityHint: Optional, 1 to 5,000: the most people the area holds. The stream flags minutes whose occupancy is above it.
zones.capacityInvalid: The physical capacity is a whole number from 1 to 5,000, or empty.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Sensors of your sites: registry, coverage on the plan, calibration and health
devices.none: No devices at this site yet
devices.noRights: You can view the devices of your sites.

fields.allowedSources: Allowed networks (one CIDR a line; none for anywhere)

devices.footprintHint: Leave the footprint empty to use the BOQ's assumed coverage for the family and height.

credential.title: The device's credential
credential.once: Shown this once. Ariva keeps only a hash: store it in the device now. A lost credential is replaced, never recovered.
credential.copied: The credential is copied. Paste it into the device, then copy something else.
credential.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the credential and copy it yourself.
credential.confirmRotate: Replace the credential now (the old one stops within a minute)

devices.moveHint: Moving, re-aiming or reassigning the device takes it back to Commissioning until a calibration passes.
devices.calibrationHint: At or above the threshold (95 % unless set) the device goes Online.
devices.planLabel: Floor plan with the queue zones and the devices' coverage
devices.heartbeat: A device is offline after {seconds} s without a heartbeat.

alertRules.title: Alert rules
alertRules.description: The rules that drive every alert, with a preview of when they would have fired
alertRules.none: No alert rules at this site yet

form.noZones: This site has no published queue zones yet.

hints.clearThreshold: Beyond this, on the clearing side, the alert clears. Empty: when the condition ends.
hints.minQueueLength: Only fire when at least this many people are queuing.
hints.leadMinutes: 15 to 60 minutes ahead, from the arrival wave of landing flights.
hints.escalation: Unacknowledged alerts go to the role or contact after this.
hints.condition: This metric is true or false: the rule fires while it is true.

preview.title: Backtest preview
preview.description: The same evaluation the live alerts come from, on the stored minutes of the range (UTC, up to a day that has ended).
preview.badRange: Choose a start and an end.
preview.never: Would not have fired in this range.
preview.fired: Would have fired {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}}, first at {first}.
preview.coverage: {withData} of {targets} targets had stored minutes in this range.
preview.truncated: Only the first 200 alerts are listed.

immigration.title: Immigration
immigration.description: Border halls: waits per lane, desks and e-gates from AMAN's interval aggregates
immigration.amanHint: Officer-level data stays in the border system and is not shown in Ariva.
immigration.lanesDescription: Waits now from the queue sensors; desks staffed now; people served and service times over the last {minutes} minutes from AMAN.
immigration.noLanes: No lane queues or desks reported for this hall yet.
immigration.eGatesUsed: {used} of {configured} gates used in the window
immigration.extraNone: No rejects in the window: no extra load on manual desks.
immigration.extraLoad: Rejects add about {deskMinutes} desk-minutes to the manual lanes (an estimate at the manual desks' mean service time).
immigration.extraWait: Spread over the desks open now, about {minutes} min of extra wait.
immigration.desksDescription: Each desk's latest state from AMAN and its interval aggregates. No officer names or ids.
immigration.desksHidden: Desk and e-gate figures are border data: your role sees the lane totals above.
immigration.noDesks: No desk has reported in this hall yet.

displays.title: Passenger displays
displays.description: Boards that show waits as bands of minutes in the site's languages
displays.none: No displays at this site yet
displays.bandSummary: {band} min bands, {hysteresis} min hysteresis, stale after {stale} s
displays.playerHint: Open this address on the display's player (kiosk browser, full screen, 1920 by 1080). It holds the player's credential: it is shown once. A new credential replaces it at once.
displays.credentialNote: Players sign in with their display's own credential, never with a user's account.

form.noZones: This site has no published queue zones yet.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Label ({language})
fields.fallback: Message when the data is stale

hints.hysteresis: The band changes only when the wait leaves it by this much.
hints.stale: Older data shows the message instead of a number.

users.title: Users and access
users.description: Accounts, their roles and sites, resets, and the audit trail
users.pick: Pick an account to see and change its roles, sites and status.
users.ownAccount: This is your own account. Change your password and authenticator under Account security; another administrator changes your roles, sites and status.
users.rolesHint: A role is granted or revoked as soon as its box changes, after a fresh second factor. Its sessions end when a role is taken away.
users.sitesHint: You can grant only the sites you can reach yourself.

form.sitesRequired: Give the account at least one of your sites.
form.sitesOptional: An account without sites reaches no site until it is given some.

temporaryPassword.title: Temporary password
temporaryPassword.once: Shown this once. Give it to the person through a channel you trust; they choose their own password and set up their authenticator at their first sign-in.
temporaryPassword.copied: The password is copied. Paste it where it goes, then copy something else.
temporaryPassword.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the password and copy it yourself.

actions.confirmDisable: Disable and end its sessions now

audit.title: Audit log
audit.utcNote: Newest first. The trail is read only: nobody, administrators included, can change or delete an entry.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: The daily report of a site: lane waits per local hour, the day's alerts and device uptime, with CSV exports and scheduled emails.
reports.noSites: No site is available to you.
reports.todayNote: Today is not over: the figures cover the hours so far, and hours with provisional minutes are marked.

headline.label: The day at a glance
headline.criticalHint: {count, plural, =0 {none critical} one {# critical} other {# critical}}
headline.uptimeHint: Share of the day without an outage

reports.stripLegend: Hour strip by P90: green under {near} min, amber from {near}, red above {over}, grey without waits.
reports.noLanes: The site has no queue zones with data for this day.
reports.outageSummary: {count, plural, =0 {no outage} one {# outage, {minutes} min} other {# outages, {minutes} min}}
reports.footnote: Local times in {zone}. P50 and P90 come from merged 30-second histograms, exact to 30 seconds. Generated {generated} UTC.

schedules.intro: A schedule emails the previous day's report to Ariva accounts allowed this site, each with the report their own roles see and the three CSV files.
schedules.recipientsHint: Only accounts that may read this site's reports are listed; free email addresses are not possible.
schedules.noRecipients: No account may receive this site's report yet.
schedules.noLongerEligible: No longer allowed this report: remove to save

errors.name: Give the schedule a name of up to 120 characters.
errors.sendAt: Give a send time as HH:MM.

illustrative.title: Illustrative, not surveyed.
illustrative.detail: {site} is modelled on a real airport from public information only; its layout, counts and positions are assumptions, not a survey.

validation.title: Validation capture
validation.description: Count people crossing a line in 15-minute bins, time tracers and log desk states minute by minute for a running validation campaign. Each bin, run and desk log is sent to Ariva as soon as it ends.
validation.noSites: Your account has no site. Ask an administrator to give you the site you observe.

campaigns.title: Running campaigns
campaigns.intro: Choose the campaign you are observing for. Only running campaigns of your site are listed.
campaigns.none: No campaign is running at this site. The campaign manager starts it; then refresh.
campaigns.scope: {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}, {zones, plural, one {# queue zone} other {# queue zones}}
campaigns.notToday: Today ({today}, site local time) is not a planned day of this campaign: Ariva refuses counts and runs outside its planned days.
campaigns.desks: {desks, plural, one {# desk} other {# desks}} to log

outbox.title: Not sent yet
outbox.waiting: {count, plural, one {# bin, run or desk log is} other {# bins, runs and desk logs are}} not sent yet. They are kept on this screen only (nothing is stored on the tablet): keep the screen open and send them again once the connection is back.
outbox.refused: Ariva refused this {kind, select, count {bin} desks {desk log} other {tracer run}}: {reason}
outbox.ownCampaign: You created or started this campaign, so you cannot count for it: its counts and runs come from other observers. Nothing was recorded.
outbox.clock: Ariva refused the run because the tablet's clock is more than 5 minutes off. Set the tablet's date and time to automatic (from the network), then time the tracer again; this run cannot be sent.
outbox.offline: No connection to Ariva; it will be sent again.
outbox.unavailable: Ariva could not take it now (HTTP {status}); it will be sent again.
outbox.deskLabel: Desk log, bin {bin} ({desks, plural, one {# desk} other {# desks}})

leave.title: Unsent work on this screen
leave.description: A tally, a tracer run or a desk log is in progress, or something is not sent yet. Leaving this screen loses it.

tally.chooseLineHint: Stand where you see the whole line. Tap In for each person crossing into the queue and Out for each person crossing out. A bin is sent when it ends.
tally.partBin: Part bin: counting started after {start}, so this bin is not sent. Counts are sent from the {next} bin.
tally.skippedPart: The bin from {start} was a part bin and was not sent.
tally.skippedStopped: Counting stopped; the bin from {start} was not complete and was not sent.

history.title: Your counts for this line
history.empty: No count recorded for this line yet.
history.caption: Your counts for {line}, newest bin first, in site local time

correction.title: Correct bin {bin}
correction.reasonHint: Say what was wrong, for example a missed group. Never name a person.
correction.invalid: Enter whole numbers from 0 to 10,000 and a reason of 1 to 200 characters.
correction.unknown: Ariva did not answer, so this correction may or may not be saved. Send again sends it as it is (it is never saved twice), or Cancel and check your counts.
correction.keyReused: Ariva already holds another correction sent with this form's key, so this one was not saved. Your counts are shown again: correct the latest revision if it is still wrong.

tracers.offset: {sign}{seconds} s against Ariva's clock, measured at {time}
tracers.notMeasured: Not measured yet: Ariva measures the tablet's clock with each run sent and corrects the run's times.
tracers.offsetLarge: The tablet's clock is more than a minute off. Set its date and time to automatic; beyond 5 minutes Ariva refuses the runs.
tracers.codeHint: The label on the campaign's roster, T-01 to T-999. Never type a name.

problems.code: A tracer code is T, a hyphen and 2 or 3 digits (T-01 to T-999); never a name.
problems.zone: Choose the queue zone the tracer joins.
problems.active: This tracer is already in a queue; record their exit first.

tracers.activeEmpty: No tracer is in a queue.
tracers.tooLong: Longer than 3 hours: Ariva refuses this run. Cancel it.
tracers.recordedCaption: Your tracer runs, latest join first, in site local time (Ariva's clock)

desks.clock: {time}, site local time. The desk log keeps its minutes on Ariva's clock, not the tablet's.
desks.clockUnknown: Ariva's clock has not been read on this screen, so the desk log follows the tablet's clock. Set the tablet's date and time to automatic.
desks.clockLost: The tablet's clock changed (set by hand or from the network, or the tablet slept), so Ariva's clock is being read again. Until it is, no tap is placed and no bin is sent; the minutes logged before are kept.
desks.clockImplausible: The tablet's clock is more than 15 minutes from Ariva's. Set the tablet's date and time to automatic: until the difference is under 15 minutes, the desk log places no tap and sends no bin.
desks.tabletAhead: The tablet's clock is {minutes} min {seconds} s ahead of Ariva's. Set the tablet's date and time to automatic; the desk log keeps to Ariva's clock.
desks.tabletBehind: The tablet's clock is {minutes} min {seconds} s behind Ariva's. Set the tablet's date and time to automatic; the desk log keeps to Ariva's clock.
desks.chooseHint: Choose up to 20 desks you can see from where you stand. Each minute, tap what each desk is doing: Serving, Idle, Paused or Closed. Each 15-minute bin is sent when it ends.
desks.chosen: {count, plural, =0 {No desk chosen} one {# desk chosen} other {# desks chosen}} (at most {max})
desks.logging: Logging {count, plural, one {# desk} other {# desks}}
desks.bin: Bin {start} to {end} (Ariva's clock, site local time); sent when it ends, in {left}
desks.binHeld: Bin {start} to {end} (Ariva's clock, site local time); sent when it ends
desks.target: Tap the state each desk shows in minute {start} to {end}.
desks.held: Waiting for Ariva's clock: taps are not placed until it is read again.
desks.earlier: You are filling in minute {time}, an earlier minute of this bin.
desks.stopConfirm: Stop and send the minutes that have ended
desks.stopped: Logging stopped. The minutes before {time} are sent; the minute in progress was not.
desks.sent: Desk log for {start} to {end} sent: {count, plural, one {# desk minute} other {# desk minutes}}.
desks.ownCampaign: You created or started this campaign, so you cannot log desks for it: its desk logs come from other observers. Nothing was recorded.
desks.deskRole: Desk states are border data: Ariva takes no desk log from this account, because it also holds an airport role. Nothing was recorded.

history.title: Your desk log
history.hint: Each minute you sent is shown in site local time. Tap a minute to correct it.
history.caption: Your desk states from {start} to {end}, site local time
history.forbidden: Desk states are border data: Ariva does not show them to this account, because it also holds an airport role.
history.failed: Could not load your desk log: {reason}

correction.title: Correct {desk} at {time}
correction.state: The state the desk really showed
correction.reasonHint: Say what was wrong, for example a tap on the wrong desk. Never name a person: the reason is kept beside the desk and the minute.
correction.invalid: Choose the state the desk really showed (not the one recorded) and give a reason of 1 to 200 characters.
correction.keyReused: Ariva already holds another correction sent with this form's key, so this one was not saved. Your desk log is shown again: correct the latest revision if it is still wrong.
